edits.original: Traditional malware—viruses, worms, and trojans—remain pervasive, but they are now augmented by ransomware that encrypts data and demands payment, supply‑chain attacks that infiltrate trusted vendors, and advanced persistent threats (APTs) that linger undetected for months.
edits.replacement: Traditional malware—viruses, worms, and trojans—remain pervasive, now augmented by ransomware that encrypts data and demands payment, supply‑chain attacks that infiltrate trusted vendors, and advanced persistent threats (APTs) that linger undetected for months.
edits.reason: The "but" clause is a padded negation windup that adds nothing once the contrast is dropped.

edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open. Fail-closed is the only acceptable default for those checks, end of story.
edits.reason: The second sentence restates the first in stronger terms without adding a new fact, so the first half is redundant filler.

edits.original: The EDR timeline ends at a truncated process tree…
edits.reason: This sentence restates the surrounding point without checkable content, leaving nothing when deleted.

edits.original: The KPI dashboard now includes mean time to contain—the finance team uses that figure in the quarterly risk report.
edits.reason: It restates the KPI point with no checkable new information, so deleting it loses nothing.

edits.original: Mean time to contain fell from 18 hours to 3 hours after the playbook change, which streamlines containment. The playbook change significantly reduces mean time to contain.
edits.replacement: Mean time to contain fell from 18 hours to 3 hours after the playbook change, which streamlines containment.
edits.reason: The second sentence merely restates that the change reduced mean time to contain, adding no new fact.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.reason: This negative-clause restatement adds nothing to the preceding least-privilege sentence.

edits.original: Positive reinforcement for reporters is now a standing practice, full stop.
edits.reason: It restates the prior reinforcement point with no new information, so it is redundant windup.

edits.original: The 5G rollout added thousands of new radios—the SOC ingested the extra syslog without a retention plan, the legal team then discovered the gap during a discovery request.
edits.reason: This clause restates the new-endpoints point with no checkable new information, leaving nothing when deleted.
